opinions.text:
Ct. App. Mich. [Certiorari granted, 459 U. S. 1168.] Motion of Timothy A. Baughman, Esquire, to permit Janice M. Joyce *1034Bartee to present oral argument pro hac vice on behalf of petitioner granted.

Application of petitioner for leave to file a brief in excess of the page limitations, presented to Justice O’Connor, and by her referred to the Court, denied.
